index: [channel, row, column]: rows from the south going north (y), columns from the west going east (x)

inputs.name: height
inputs.units: m above the ground: the tallest block over the cell's centre, 0 for none

inputs.name: ground
inputs.units: m, the ground at the cell's centre above the ground under the charge

inputs.name: distance
inputs.units: m, in plan from the charge to the cell's centre

inputs.name: logScaledDistance
inputs.units: ln(Z), Z = max(distance, cell / 2) / W^(1/3) in m/kg^(1/3)

inputs.name: kingeryBulmashPeak
inputs.units: Pa, incident peak overpressure of a hemispherical surface burst at Z

inputs.name: kingeryBulmashImpulse
inputs.units: Pa s, incident positive impulse at Z

mask: 1 where the target is air at the height and at least edgeCells from the side faces

targets.name: peakOverpressure
targets.units: Pa, the run's largest overpressure in the cell at the height

targets.name: impulse
targets.units: Pa s, the run's positive-phase impulse in the cell at the height

targets.name: firstPhaseImpulse
targets.units: Pa s, the first positive phase's impulse at the height, by the façade recorder's rule: from the start until the overpressure first falls below nothing after reaching half its peak
